events.name: TAKIN’ IT TO THE LIMIT – Eagles Tribute
events.description: Two bands, The Fabulous Armadillos and Collective Unconscious, return to present a tribute concert to the Eagles. Audiences sing and dance along to hits such as “Take It Easy,” “Life in the Fast Lane,” and “Desperado.”

events.name: S2 E5: FLUID FREQUENCIES – HALLOWEEN
events.description: Get ready to dive into a night of wicked bass, bold creativity, and an incredible sense of community at FLUID FREQUENCIES S2E5: FLUID FREQUENCIES HALLOWEEN. The event brings together an all-woman, non-binary, and queer lineup of local artists, DJs, painters, flow artists, and vendors.

events.name: Intuition & Equalibrum, The Teach a Man To Fish Tour
events.venue: The Hook and Ladder Event Center, Zen Arcade Stage
events.description: INTUITION & EQUALIBRUM ARE FINALLY PLAYING THEIR FIRST SHOW IN MINNEAPOLIS, JOINED BY SPEAK, ON THEIR FIRST HEADLINING TOUR!

events.name: NEIL! Martin Zellar’s Tribute To Neil Diamond
events.description: Martin Zellar and his band pay tribute to the iconic music of legendary performer Neil Diamond. They perform popular songs including “Sweet Caroline,” “Cherry, Cherry,” “Forever in Blue Jeans,” “Solitary Man,” “America,” and “Cracklin’ Rosie.”

events.name: Little River Band
events.description: Little River Band garnered huge chart success with multi-platinum albums and chart-topping hits in the ’70s and ’80s.

events.name: Rockin’ Hollywoods ‘Halloween Dance’
events.description: Get ready to dance the night away at the Rockin’ Hollywoods Halloween Dance at Medina Entertainment Center. Join us for classic rock ’n’ roll hits, a spirited costume contest, and nonstop fun.
